questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: At det var Australien, og leveomkostningerne. Wollongong er betydeligt billigere end Sydney/Melbourne, og derfor var det muligt for mig at få råd til udvekslingsopholdet.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Meget nemt. De havde et kæmpe Student Help Center, med bemanding hver dag.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Skulle have hjælp til mit skema fordi nogle fag overlappede, men pga hybrid undervisning var dette ikke noget problem.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: Jeg var ikke i stand til at deltage i orientation, fordi det tog mig 5 dage at komme derned pga aflyste og forsinkede fly..

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Som udvekslingselev på UOW er du garanteret housing hvis man ansøger inden fristen. De har 5-6 forskellige student housing bygninger, både on og off campus, der hver især tilbyder noget forskellige. Jeg boede c. 10-15 min fra campus, men de har en gratis city loop bus, der kører lige fra kollegiet til campus. Meget nemt.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Jeg boede tæt på stranden, det var derfor jeg valgte off campus. I Wollongong er det meget nemt at komme omkring med den gratis bus.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Ville anbefale self-catered. Lejlighederne er meget større og pænere, og maden er ikke synderligt imponerende, så jeg endte alligevel med at bruge en masse penge på min egen morgenmad og aftensmad.

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Sørg for at have de påkrævede dokumenter; engelsk-talende bevis osv. Find kurser (husk at vælge Wollongong campus) og sørg for at du enten opfylder prerequisites eller at faget ikke har nogle.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: De har en email kun for Exchange / Study Abroad hvor man kan spørge om hjælp.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Fik godkendt alle de fag jeg ønskede.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Det er nemt, og selv hvis man kommer derned og fortryder et fag, så er der en 'prøveperiode' på 2-4 uger hvor man droppe fag og skrive sig op til nogle nye.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Sidsteårs niveau på postgraduate fag.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Meget anderledes system. De vægter forskellige assessments henover semestret med procenter, så man er nødt til at engagere sig hele tiden for overhovedet at bestå faget (over 50). Derudover er der min. præsentation for final exam, og hvis man ikke opnår det, så får man technical fail.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
CSIT985 - Strategic Network Design
CSIT882 - Database Management Systems
ECT8364 - Data Communications
ISIT906 - Information Design & Content Management

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Hvis man har tænkt sig at arbejde med databaser fremover, så er CSIT882 og ISIT906 gode fag. ISIT906 har det laveste niveau af de fire fag, så det er lidt mere stille og roligt.

questions.question: Insurance DKK *
Housing DKK per month *
Books DKK per month *
Local transportation DKK per month *
Food DKK per month *
Personal spending DKK per month *
Communication (phone, internet, etc.) DKK per month *
Other fees DKK per month *
What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Mad. Morgenmad og aftensmad var inkluderet i min husleje, men det var ikke særlig godt, så endte med at købe mit eget alligevel og lave det i min lejlighed.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Brugte færre penge på offentlig transport pga den gratis bybus.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Alt. Svømning, fodbold, løb, lgbtq+, skak osv..

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Jeg spillede fodbold hver torsdag, det var fedt.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Sydney ligger en togtur væk, ca. 1-1,5 time. Meget nemt. Ellers er der meget natur omkring Wollongong, så der er masser at udforske. Wollongong er ikke den største by, men har stadig et stor shoppingcenter.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Meget nemt.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Mine fag var 99.9% udvekslingsstudenter, så jeg var mest sammen med andre study abroad studerende. Ellers er der mange cafeer og restauranter på campus, så det er nemt at møde andre.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Mest undervisningsstilen.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Menneskenes imødekommenhed og åbenhed på gaden.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1) For mig, på kandidaten/MA, var niveauet højere end hvad jeg har været vant til. Overvej derfor dette. Andre danskere var kun på BA niveau og sagde at de intet undervisning havde nærmest, og at det var nemt. Der er derfor stor forskel!
2) Wollongong er nemt fordi det er meget billigere end Sydney, men samtidig er det stadig nemt at komme til Sydney hvis man begynder at få økuller.
3) Jeg boede på Campus East, og kan godt anbefale det, men vælg self-catered, for lejlighederne er så meget bedre.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: De er virkelig gode til at hjælpe deres studerende, så der er altid hjælp at hente, og de er så søde.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: De søde mennesker jeg mødte og havde nogle fantastiske oplevelser med.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: At tilpasse mig det faglige niveau. Jeg havde undervisning hver dag, og om onsdagen havde jeg undervisning fra 08.30 til 20.30 (dog med pauser), men jeg kom fra at være vant til undervisning 2-3 gange om ugen, så det var virkelig en voldsom omvæltning.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
